svg.title: Word embedding space
svg.desc: Two-dimensional projections of word embeddings: semantically related words (city, food, travel, feeling, relative, body part) form clusters, and words also cluster by part of speech (noun, verb, adjective, adverb, pronoun).

g.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
